question: Does affine sampling itself or P3 robust aggregation explain the raw full-dimensional P3 advantage over P2?

factorial_cells.A: same-grid sampling plus uniform arithmetic mean
factorial_cells.B: same-grid sampling plus P3 confidence-weighted componentwise median
factorial_cells.C: visible-anchor affine bilinear sampling plus uniform arithmetic mean
factorial_cells.D: visible-anchor affine bilinear sampling plus P3 confidence-weighted componentwise median

matching_contract.donor_support: intersection of affine-observed and same-grid-valid for each center, mask, target, and donor
matching_contract.confidence: the same affine-derived donor confidence logit is passed to all four cells; uniform cells validate but intentionally ignore it
matching_contract.robust_tie_break: locked P3 stable componentwise weighted-median rule
matching_contract.unavailable_target_policy: fail the experiment rather than impute if any target has zero common donors
matching_contract.reason_for_intersection: prevents padded same-grid tokens or unequal donor availability from masquerading as a sampling or aggregation effect
matching_contract.unavoidable_difference: uniform aggregation mathematically has no donor confidence weights; this omission is the intended aggregation intervention

metric.primary: equal-center mean of per-target 1-cosine in the original full 768-dimensional DINO space
metric.uncertainty: 100000 paired center bootstrap replicates with seed 20260913

locked_decision_rules.stop_transport_branch: both C-vs-A and D-vs-B relative reductions are below 0.05
transport_survives: at least one of C-vs-A or D-vs-B relative reduction is at least 0.05
the absolute C-vs-A gain explains at least half of the absolute D-vs-A gain
C is better than A in at least four of five folds
aggregation_survives: B-vs-A and D-vs-C relative reductions are each at least 0.02
B is better than A and D is better than C in at least four of five folds each
interaction_survives: the transport-main-effect rule does not pass
locked_decision_rules.aggregation_dominates_uniform_transport: absolute B-vs-A gain exceeds absolute C-vs-A gain

interpretation_limits: This is a reconstruction-mechanism diagnostic, not an activity-classification result.
No threshold or rule may be changed after results are observed.
A passing mechanism gate does not authorize a task fit.
The adaptive 128-center cohort is not a new untouched confirmation set.
